detail.text: What is left is exactly the integral points of one elliptic curve, 232425.a1: the LMFDB computes them from a Mordell–Weil basis with an elliptic-logarithm bound (Stroeker–Tzanakis 1994; Sage/Magma IntegralPoints). Mathlib has neither Mordell–Weil for a specific curve nor a Baker-type lower bound for linear forms in elliptic logarithms, so the hole is not formalisable today and is not split further: any split would be a restatement. The model is the LMFDB minimal one, so its integral points are …

route.text: Reduce the pair equation to integral points on the minimal model of the elliptic curve 232425.a1 (y^2 + y = x^3 - 525x + 10156) by x = 15m(m-5)/2 + 25, y = 225n(n-3)/2 + 112; partial PR #1179 proves the map and reads the binomial solutions off the curve's integral points, one hole = that list.
